name: NuBlox Developer Handoff Pack

authentication.permission_authority: NuBlox roles, member overrides, granular/umbrella permission resolution, tenant record scope, project scope and domain policy
authentication.signup_policy: fail-closed; exactly one validated invitation or self-service organisation-bootstrap intent is required

account_provisioning.email_delivery_policy: provider-neutral; console local/integration only; production provider pending
account_provisioning.token_policy: random 256-bit invitation token; only SHA-256 hash persisted
account_provisioning.activation_policy: new membership activates only after persisted Better Auth email verification

organisation_bootstrap.token_policy: short-lived HMAC-SHA256 signed HttpOnly bootstrap token derived from BETTER_AUTH_SECRET; no bootstrap-intent persistence table
organisation_bootstrap.new_user_pending_state: pending users + pending organisation + invited owner membership until verified email
organisation_bootstrap.activation_policy: verified email transactionally activates domain user, verified user email, organisation and owner membership
organisation_bootstrap.existing_user_policy: active NuBlox user can create an additional organisation without duplicating auth/domain identity
organisation_bootstrap.permission_parity_policy: forward permission migrations for existing organisations and OrganisationBootstrapService defaults for future organisations must remain aligned

permission_granularity.resolution_policy: resolve granular key first; use umbrella only when granular decision is default-deny
permission_granularity.deny_policy: an explicit granular member deny cannot be bypassed by an umbrella member/role grant
permission_granularity.compatibility_policy: existing custom roles with project.manage or crm.manage remain compatible through umbrella fallback unless a granular member exception applies

permission_split.organisation.manage: organisation role definitions, permission grants and full organisation-administration authority
permission_split.member.manage: member lifecycle and member role assignment

organisation_administration.delegation_policy: non-organisation-managers may delegate only role permissions they effectively hold themselves
organisation_administration.manager_protection: lower-level member administrators cannot change the status or roles of organisation managers
organisation_administration.lockout_policy: member and role mutations cannot remove the final active organisation.manage authority

permission_policy.crm.party.manage: party master data, lifecycle, business classifications and primary contact methods
permission_policy.crm.manage: umbrella fallback for party and contact management

crm.identity_policy: Package 002 parties are private tenant-owned CRM records and are distinct from NuBlox platform organisations, users, organisation members, workforce identities and project participation
crm.tenant_policy: all party/contact repository access is scoped by active organisation_id; cross-tenant public IDs are masked as not found
crm.subtype_policy: party_kind is enforced by the service transaction so each created party has exactly one matching party_persons or party_organisations subtype
crm.role_policy: party_role_assignments classify one party into multiple business roles without duplicating party identity and do not grant application permissions
crm.contact_method_policy: first UI maintains one primary email and one primary E.164 phone while preserving the normalised multi-contact-method schema
crm.organisation_contact_policy: person-to-organisation job title, department, primary-contact status and dated relationship evidence live on party_organisation_contacts
crm.archive_policy: archived parties cannot receive new contact relationships

project_workspace.read_policy: project.view plus active project_organisations participation plus exact active project_members membership
project_workspace.create_policy: project.create plus active organisation membership; creation atomically creates owner participation, creator project membership and audit evidence
project_workspace.lifecycle_policy: project.lifecycle.manage with project.manage umbrella fallback plus active project scope, owning-organisation context and valid lifecycle transition
project_workspace.external_participant_policy: explicitly scoped external participants may view but cannot mutate owner project lifecycle
project_workspace.participant_administration: ProjectTeamService separates participant, team and participation responsibilities with project.manage retained as umbrella fallback

project_collaboration.invitation_policy: owning organisation invites an active NuBlox organisation by exact public_id; no unrestricted organisation directory
project_collaboration.invitation_response_policy: active invited-organisation member with organisation-level project.participation.manage or project.manage umbrella fallback may accept/decline before project_members scope exists
project_collaboration.acceptance_policy: acceptance atomically activates project_organisations participation and creates/reactivates accepting member project_members scope
project_collaboration.participant_management_policy: project.participant.manage or umbrella fallback; only owning organisation may invite/remove participants or manage project_organisation_roles
project_collaboration.team_management_policy: scoped project.team.manage or umbrella fallback permits a participant organisation to manage only its own active organisation members
project_collaboration.participation_management_policy: project.participation.manage or umbrella fallback governs invitation response and non-owner voluntary leave
project_collaboration.role_policy: project_role_types/project_organisation_roles/project_member_roles are contextual metadata and never grant permissions
project_collaboration.lockout_policy: final active scoped member with effective project.team.manage, including umbrella fallback, cannot be removed until another scoped team manager exists
project_collaboration.leave_policy: non-owner participant may leave; leave/removal terminates all active project_members scope for that organisation while preserving history
